title: Nakaya's conjectures on the linear factors and degree of Fricke supersingular polynomials: manuscript and PARI/GP verification
description:
Manuscript (LaTeX source and PDF) and exact PARI/GP and Python verification code for a deduction of Nakaya's Conjectures 5 and 6 on the supersingular polynomials attached to the Fricke groups Γ0(N)+, at all fourteen odd prime levels N in Nakaya's set, with versions at other odd prime levels, and a uniform form of Nakaya's Conjecture 4 (resultant multiplicities) at all fifteen levels of his set. Includes stored modular relations, computed polynomials, CSV files and run logs.

Code (verification/, exploratory/) is released under the MIT licence; the manuscript in paper/ is not covered by that licence (all rights reserved), as stated in the repository's LICENSE file.
